newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Coconut oil prices seen steady in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Coconut oil prices seen steady in quiet trade.

text.p: Coconut oil prices are seen steady in sluggish trade this week due to the Easter holidays, brokers said.

"Most players are out of the market and most people in the provinces have their operations slowing down. We expect nearby prices to come down just a little bit but forward prices will hold," said one senior trader.
The Philippines is the biggest exporter of coconut oil.
"We will definitely be inactive because of the Holy Week,"said another vegetable oil dealer.
But the trader said competition from Indonesia is likely to heighten pressure to lower coconut oil prices in the next few weeks.
Prices of copra, on the other hand, are also expected to dip in the coming weeks on better weather conditions in the southern island of Mindanao, another trader added.

"We see gradual sign of improved arrivals from Mindanao due to good weather and when rice farmers finish harvesting, they would then resort to copra, thus increasing production levels," the trader added.
Mindanao accounts for 55 percent of the Philippine coconut production and 80 percent of the country's total exports, the trader noted.
